verdict.rationale: BVNK is API-first, so it can run without a UI: API keys with Hawk signatures authenticate each request, and a sandbox with a pay-in simulation endpoint lets automated tests run without financial risk. A probe also found an official agent-wallet CLI, but the pack gives no detail on it, and nothing documents CI pipelines or non-interactive tooling. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD usage guidance, documented CLI capabilities for headless runs, independent or hands-on corroboration of automated pipeline usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: you use your Hawk Auth ID and Secret Key to generate a signature for each API request.
The sandbox environment mirrors production but operates with test data, allowing you to build and validate your integration without financial risk.
To simulate pay-ins with different currencies and payment methods, in the sandbox environment, send the POST /payment/v2/payins/simulation
access payment capabilities through the BVNK portal or API for your own use
